arguments.command:
cd /tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, random
from math import gcd
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/t')
import exact, gen, ref, refrep
ns = {}
exec(open('/tmp/t/run3.py').read().split("rng = random.Random")[0], ns)
gen_trace = ns['gen_trace']
rng = random.Random(99)
reqs = []
prof = gen.gen_profile(rng)
fab = gen.gen_fabric(rng, prof)
feas, upper, _ = ref.ref_calib(prof)
reqs.append({'op': 'calibrate', 'profile': prof})
reqs.append({'op': 'plan', 'profile': prof, 'fabric': fab})
plan = exact.compile_plan(prof, fab)
reqs.append({'op': 'audit', 'profile': prof, 'fabric': fab, 'proposal': plan})
tr = gen_trace(rng, prof, fab, upper)
reqs.append({'op': 'replay', 'profile': prof, 'fabric': fab, 'guard_ns': fab['guards_ns'][0], 'trace': tr})
inp = '\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs) + '\n'
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=inp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'stderr', p.stderr[:500])
out = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
print('lines', len(out))
for o in out:
    print(json.dumps(o)[:160])
assert out[3] == exact.replay(prof, fab, fab['guards_ns'][0], tr)
assert out[1] == plan
assert out[2] == {'valid': True}
assert out[0] == exact.calibrate(prof)
print('ALL MATCH')
# format check
p2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/workspace/format_check.py'], input=p.stdout, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(p2.stdout, p2.stderr)
EOF
